completed_data_integrity.pass: all required native/derived completed bars contiguous and known_at<=decision

approach_state.clean: reaction then same-direction M15 CONF without intervening opposite BOS/CONF
approach_state.corrective: opposite BOS/CONF allowed while structural boundary remains intact; final selected M15 CONF must return to candidate direction before decision
approach_state.invalid: structural close-through, source retirement/consumption, missing causal evidence, or no same-direction CONF before retirement

htf_context.pass: candidate direction admissible under inherited v3 HTF state contract

refinement_and_poi.pass: valid same-direction causal refinement and unconsumed eligible POI

structural_invalidation.pass: completed price has not closed through immutable family invalidation boundary

fta_lifecycle.selection: nearest valid signed-forward structural FTA only

decision_mark_rule.LONG: latest completed M15 close < selected FTA
decision_mark_rule.SHORT: latest completed M15 close > selected FTA

entry_geometry.technical_execution_envelope: structural zone expanded by exactly one active grid unit per side

payoff_gate.stop_unit: cost-inclusive modeled cash stop unit K

reservation_and_order.lifetime: event-driven structural validity, capped by inherited 16h parent pending ceiling

execution.same_bar_ambiguity: WAIT/UNKNOWN if OHLC cannot prove event ordering

exit_and_accounting.protective_stop: family structural stop inherited from v3
exit_and_accounting.funding: actual signed historical funding while open
